interpretation: The best variant extends the iADP state and cost with integrated rate-tracking error; it is not merely a hyperparameter change.
iADPAgent and F-16 production equations were not changed for these examples.
Parameter selection uses healthy-only trajectories and a common external rate-error/control cost.
Performance improves versus the original setup and versus PID for the tested 10% and 15% faults.
PID wins the 20% fault post-event RMSE comparison and has a slightly lower peak error for the default 15% fault.
Freezing the improved iADP model/critic at the event is slightly better than continued adaptation here; integral action remains active.
No claim of universal convergence, equal tuning budgets or superiority of online adaptation is supported by these tests.

paper.note: The causal z state in this example is our experimental formulation, not a reproduction of the flight-test controller.
